If you fancy pizza in Vietnam here is not bad!
Jan 2026 • Friends
I state that I do not usually eat Italian abroad and here they brought me, but despite being skeptical the pizza was not bad at all! I recommend the one with the salami (peppers), while the one with chicken kebab I found a little too sweet. But what pleasantly surprised me was that they make the dough as well as the sandwiches, which looked good to see, and even the pasta is homemade! For me, therefore, it is promoted.

Yummy Italian food in Sapa
Jan 2026 • Couples
Great experience in Pi’s Kitchen. We ate here twice while staying in Sapa. 
We had lunch one day, and dinner the next. It was exactly what we needed. 
The food was delicious and fresh, the restaurant was lovely and the staff were extremely polite. 
Our order was taken promptly and the food was ready in good time, tasting amazing. 

Would highly recommend if you’re visiting Sapa.
